items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill, Niels Henning, and Alan Dawson... we ended up playing as two separate trios and just under the contract we played that last tune as a quartet... enjoyed playing with those two guys a lot.

ctx.x: When you and Bill played together that’s sixty-five.

Yeah. Bill, Niels Henning, and Alan Dawson. Bill was in bad shape and we ended up playing as two separate trios and just under the contract we played that last tune as a quartet. But that turned out great for me because I stretched out and enjoyed playing with those two guys a lot.
What was Bill’s problem? Was it drugs at the time?
